children: Paraguay’s trade balance swung to a deficit of $50.84 million in August 2026, from a $25.12 million surplus a year earlier.
Imports surged 21.1% year over year to $1.85 billion.
Purchases of consumer goods grew 13.1%, imports of intermediate goods rose 23%, and capital goods purchases increased 24.9%.
Sales of manufactured goods of agricultural and livestock origin rose 8.6%, while exports of industrial manufactured goods jumped 23.6% and sales of fuels and energy increased 13.9%.
In contrast, exports of primary products fell 2.1%.

title: Paraguay Trade Balance Swings to Deficit
